collection.title: Suzuki SJ 410 1982 to 1991 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Suzuki SJ 410 1982 - 1991 model requires a 11" wiper blade on both the drivers side and the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
